**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 7.2, p0026).**

- **Issue:** § 7.2 runs the MFN *against* us — before engaging another provider, Customer must disclose to Vendor and match any more favourable commercial offer it receives. Open-ended as to product, duration, and comparability, so it fails the fallback (defined product / 12 months / reasonable-comparison carve-outs) and lands in walk-away territory.
- **Internal conflict:** § 12.3 has Vendor acknowledge that Customer made no most-favoured-customer commitment, so § 7.2 is also inconsistent with the rest of the bargain.
- **Redline (validated, preferred position):** delete p0026 in full. No Vendor-granted MFN exists in the document, so nothing beneficial to us is lost.
